Our mission/Meet the Team

The people behind OSI

Meet
the team.

A stronger community starts with people who show up.

Since 2023, Oakland Service Initiative has brought people together to serve Oakland County. Our team and volunteers give their time to food assistance, environmental projects, health and hospice volunteering, community events, and technology education.
